# Real BDF corpus

`sq.bdf` and `sqb.bdf` are Christian Neukirchen's regular and bold **sq** 7×15 pixel fonts, downloaded 2026-09-28 from `https://github.com/leahneukirchen/sq` at the repository's `master` raw URLs. The author states in [README.md](https://github.com/leahneukirchen/sq/blob/master/README.md) that this work is public domain and waives rights under [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). No artwork was changed; the files are kept byte-for-byte for independent BDF import tests. `sq` was redrawn by the author with influence from another font; this is the upstream author's own release claim.

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `sq.bdf` | `a0d1dfa1696ea4ba4fba7807d1ffee0d6f83bb3ef8cdce5b8615ebee7d437cc6` |
| `sqb.bdf` | `ca1f2f4abef0ff07fe32712f7fa6b530920555c538a40257453eadf3ed05ab63` |

The existing CC0 Bellanger PNG sheet under `tests/fixtures/game/corpus/fonts/` is a separate image-sheet import corpus; its provenance is recorded in that corpus.
